questions.q: What is the command in Ash-Shu'ara 26:214?
questions.explain: This command began the open call to the family.

questions.q: Who was the only one to declare support at the family feast?
questions.explain: Ali prepared the feast and promised to help.

questions.q: What did Abu Lahab do after eating at the first feast?
options: Got up and broke up the gathering

questions.q: What did Utbah and Utaybah, sons of Abu Lahab, do?
options: Divorced Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum at their father's urging
questions.explain: The public divorce was meant to break the Prophet's morale.

options: An opponent still open to consideration, like Abu Talib and Al-Abbas
questions.explain: Not all opponents are the same.

questions.q: Kinship alone saves a person from punishment.
questions.explain: False. The Prophet SAW could not shield family from punishment; each person chooses.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW made sure Quraysh affirmed his honesty before giving the warning.
questions.explain: True. Credibility was tested before the message was delivered.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Abu Lahab is condemned in a surah
Abu Lahab breaks up the feast
The call to all of Makkah

questions.explain: The command, the first feast broken up, Ali's support, the call to all Makkah, and then Abu Lahab was condemned.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A morning cry that grabs attention
The clan of the Prophet SAW

questions.explain: Banu Hashim is his clan, ya sabahah is a morning cry, naba' is great news, and lahab is a blazing flame.
